words.gloss_range: simple active saying introducing a quoted question; not reporting, supposing, or passive attribution here
words.root_gloss_range: broad speech-root range including uttered speech, report, public talk, attribution, supposition, and inner saying; the local Form I verb selects direct articulated speech
words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) opens the ayah as a compact completed speech turn: the prior narrative speaker is recovered from context, while the 3ms active form separates that single questioner from the plural addressees. The verb frames the whole following question and vocative as one quoted speech act, using plain Form I saying rather than report, causative speech, passive attribution, or inward thought. It also carries a dialogue handoff: the q-w-l chain moves out of the prior reported exchange into a direct question, belongs to the repeated Abraham-angel mission-inquiry pattern (15:57; more broadly 11:77), and creates the answer slot filled by the plural reply in 51:32. The stop-heavy opening sound only reinforces that the next speech turn is not casual narration but a serious inquiry.

topics.headline: recoverable single speaker against plural addressees
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speaker is compressed but not vague: a single recovered questioner actively addresses a plural group.
topics.reason: The 3ms active perfect has no overt subject, but the attachment evidence supplies a recoverable prior speaker and distinguishes him from the plural addressees.

topics.headline: completed direct speech frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the line as one completed quoted question, not as narrator summary or interior reflection.
topics.reason: The verb governs the following question as quoted content, and the local root branch is ordinary uttered speech.

topics.headline: plain saying over report-specific branches
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the directness of the exchange: the word voices the question rather than turning it into a report, caused speech, or attribution.
topics.reason: V4 lists many q-w-l branches, but the local Form I quoted-speech frame narrows the payoff to direct articulated saying.

topics.headline: mission inquiry and answer echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this opening verb as the question side of a known mission-disclosure exchange, especially with 15:57 and the reply in 51:32.
topics.reason: The echoes are real as formula and dialogue movement, while the local parse remains the present ayah's quoted question rather than being controlled by another scene.

topics.headline: boundary handoff into direct address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the scene pivot from prior reported speech into a new face-to-face inquiry.
topics.reason: The verb opens a new quoted unit after the previous ayah's report chain and therefore works as a discourse boundary.

topics.headline: stop-heavy opening prepares the serious question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can notice that the opening sound texture supports the grave-question turn without changing the grammar.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation is local and modest, so it is retained as acoustic coloring rather than lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: connective particle linking the prior reassurance to the mission question with sequence and consequence
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the question follow from the previous scene rather than restart abruptly. Its payoff is both sequence and consequence: after fear has been answered and the annunciation has closed, the discourse can turn to the visitors' purpose. Because the connector is fused directly onto the interrogative surface, the transition and the question are heard as one immediate move; even the lighter onset lets the inquiry glide forward before landing on the heavier grave-affair noun.

topics.headline: reassurance-to-inquiry bridge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the mission question is motivated by the prior reassurance, not detached from it.
topics.reason: The particle sits at the boundary of the quoted question and coherently links 51:30's reassurance to 51:31's inquiry.

topics.headline: connector fused to the question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the transition and the interrogative as one joined surface move, so the question does not float free from the prior turn.
topics.reason: The proclitic connector is attached to the following interrogative, preserving both continuity and immediacy.

topics.headline: single-particle scene pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one small particle carrying the psychological shift from fear resolved to mission requested.
topics.reason: The row family identifies the particle as the local hinge between emotional resolution and functional inquiry.

words.gloss_range: interrogative pronoun functioning as the fronted predicate of a nominal question
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) supplies a real interrogative, not negation or rebuke. As the fronted predicate of a verbless nominal question, it puts the unknown first and asks for the nature of an already present affair rather than narrating an action. The word targets mission content, not visitor identity: the later vocative classifies the addressees, while this interrogative requests what their commission is. Because the phrase recurs in the parallel encounter formula (15:57), the question-word is part of a stable mission-disclosure pattern, and its joined surface with the preceding connector keeps that request tied to the prior turn.

topics.headline: unknown element placed first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the line asks for identification of an existing affair, with the unknown placed at the front.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as the fronted interrogative predicate in a nominal question.

topics.headline: question targets commission content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the requested unknown is what the visitors carry or intend, not who they are.
topics.reason: The vocative identifies the addressed class, so the interrogative is best read as a request for mission content.

topics.headline: surface resolved as question grammar
topics.reader_payoff: The reader avoids mistaking the same surface form for another function; here it keeps full question force.
topics.reason: The direct-speech frame and nominal predication narrow the ambiguous surface to interrogative use.

topics.headline: formulaic question before the address tail
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the mission question strikes before the addressee label and belongs to a repeated formula (15:57).
topics.reason: The word stands in the core question before the vocative and participates in the supplied parallel formula.

words.gloss_range: your grave affair or mission-matter, locally the possessed noun completing the nominal question
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes formal address, grave affair, proposal language, variegated coloring, and idioms of quarry coming within reach; the local noun selects the weighty-affair branch, with formal-speech pressure nearby
words.prose: {{ar:خَطْبُكُمْ}} ({{tr:khaṭbukum}}) is the delayed nominal head that completes the fronted question, so the clause asks, in effect, what this standing affair is rather than what action the visitors are doing. The suffix makes the affair specifically theirs, and the singular construct gathers the plural group's purpose into one unified commission. Lexically, the selected branch is a grave or consequential affair: the abstract noun makes the mission feel like a defined case awaiting disclosure, not a routine need. The wider kh-ṭ-b family of formal address and proposal language stays only as controlled pressure, because the local sense is the weighty matter that demands an announced account. Its rarity, formulaic pairing with the same mission question in 15:57, and answer by the sending verb in 51:32 make the word the ayah's hinge; even the rough consonant cluster and the 51:30 knowledge frame intensify the sense that the unknown affair is already weighty.

topics.headline: delayed noun completes the question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question identifies a standing affair, with the known domain delayed after the unknown.
topics.reason: The noun is marked as nominative delayed subject in the nominal question, not as an object of a verb.

topics.headline: their one commission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the plural visitors bound to one shared mission rather than several separate errands.
topics.reason: The possessive suffix addresses the group, while the singular noun packages their affair as one commission.

topics.headline: grave affair over routine matter
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the seriousness before the answer arrives: the word asks about a consequential affair, not casual visitor business.
topics.reason: The V4 branch for a weighty affair matches the local noun, and the CRITICAL rows tie that sense to the mission question.

topics.headline: formal-address root pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grave matter is drawn into formal speech: the affair is something that must be stated by the envoys.
topics.reason: The formal-address and proposal branches are not the selected local sense, but they validly color why this grave affair is elicited through speech.

topics.headline: rare formulaic mission hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this noun as the narrative hinge because rarity, the exact formula (15:57), and the answer in 51:32 converge on it.
topics.reason: The distributional and inter-ayah evidence supports a marked mission-inquiry formula without overriding the local syntax.

topics.headline: question creates the next answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an information gap opened here and filled by the next ayah's sending answer (51:32), under the prior divine-knowledge frame (51:30).
topics.reason: The noun's question-answer dependency points forward to 51:32 while the boundary row links it back to 51:30.

topics.headline: rough sound and scarcity intensify weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can register that the noun is marked both by scarcity and by a heavy sound shape suited to the grave-affair sense.
topics.reason: The rarity and sound-shape rows add local color to the already established grave-affair payoff.

words.gloss_range: formal vocative carrier with attention-marking force, requiring the following definite appositive
words.prose: {{ar:أَيُّهَا}} ({{tr:ayyuhā}}) is not a self-contained address. It requires the following definite appositive, so the final title is syntactically necessary rather than ornamental. Its fused attention marker makes the call formal: after the mission question has been asked, the addressees are hailed directly as the party responsible to answer. Because this vocative comes after the question, the line first presses the matter and only then classifies the visitors, turning the ending into a delayed envoy-label and marking the move from annunciation to a new mission-inquiry transaction.

topics.headline: vocative needs the final title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final title is required by the address grammar, not loosely added.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following definite participle as appositive to the vocative carrier.

topics.headline: formal second-person hailing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a face-to-face call that makes the visitors answerable inside the speech act.
topics.reason: The vocative and attention marker shift the line into direct address, not aside-commentary about the visitors.

topics.headline: question first, class label second
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the delayed classification: the mission question strikes first, then the visitors are named by function.
topics.reason: The vocative follows the core question and helps shift from personal tidings into a new mission-inquiry exchange.

words.gloss_range: the definite sent ones, a Form IV passive participle naming the addressees by commissioned dispatch
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes sending, release, messenger/message, easy movement, succession, milk flow, trustful ease, reciprocal correspondence, and specialized names; the local passive participle selects commissioned sending, with release imagery only as coloring
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ}} ({{tr:al-mursalūna}}) completes the vocative as a definite nominative plural appositive, so the address lands on an identified class: the sent ones. The passive participle names them by what has been done to them; they are recipients of dispatch, not autonomous senders, and the unnamed sender remains upstream in the grammar. The broader r-s-l release image is useful only as coloring for commissioned sending: they are let forth from authority while bound to a mission, not merely loose or relaxed. As the final word, the title retrospectively turns the whole question into a mission question to envoys, then points forward to the sending answer in 51:32 and the continuing same-surah thread in 51:33. Its liaison from the vocative and final nasal cadence make that grammatical completion audible as well as structural. Cross-references sharpen but do not replace the local referent: 15:57 supplies the close mission formula, 51:52 gives an opposite reception of a messenger, and 77:1 shows the passive-participle title can be broader elsewhere while here the addressees are the specific visitors in this scene.

topics.headline: identified plural title completes the call
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the visitors identified by function as the definite sent ones, not left as an indefinite group.
topics.reason: The definite nominative plural participle is appositive to the vocative carrier and agrees with the plural addressees.

topics.headline: sent, not self-directed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices upstream agency: the visitors carry a commission because they have been sent.
topics.reason: The local form is a Form IV passive participle, so other r-s-l branches are narrowed to the commissioned-sending sense.

topics.headline: release imagery under commission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the sent ones as released from a sender while still bound to that sender's task.
topics.reason: The release branch does not replace the local messenger title, but it sharpens the image of dispatch.

topics.headline: agent, message, and mission converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the prior affair-question naturally asks for the content of their dispatch.
topics.reason: The r-s-l field of messenger, message, and sent agent fits the local question seeking the mission they carry.

topics.headline: final title reframes the question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah close on envoy identity, which retrospectively makes the whole utterance a mission question.
topics.reason: The appositive comes after the question and is the final word, so it functions as both closure and reclassification.

topics.headline: title launches the sending answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the lexical handoff from the title here to the sending explanation in 51:32 and continued mission language in 51:33.
topics.reason: The same root is taken up in the next answer and continues in the nearby same-surah sequence.

topics.headline: parallel and contrast references
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare this local envoy address with the close formula in 15:57, the rejected messenger scene in 51:52, and the broader title usage in 77:1.
topics.reason: The references are useful as parallel and contrast, while the local referent remains the specific addressed visitors.

topics.headline: recitation binding and lingering closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the final title as syntactically bound to the call and acoustically weighted as the ayah's landing word.
topics.reason: The liaison and final cadence support the already established vocative-appositive relation.

1. **Hospitality gives way to commissioned purpose.** `خ ط ب/B003` supplies a weighty affair and `ر س ل/B002` messenger/message. Once fear and birth-news are resolved, the host asks for the matter that organized their arrival. I infer **recognized envoy status -> request for operative commission**. *Khaṭb* reads as the grave business around which their prior concealment coheres.
2. **Directed address requests a directed mission.** `خ ط ب/B001` gives directed verbal exchange and `ر س ل/B001` being sent forth. The vocative *ayyuhā* makes the question formally targeted. identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili dal sözü yalnızca büyük bir olayı değil, meydana gelen işi, o işi doğuran nedeni ve özellikle ağır olup çok konuşulan durumu birlikte verir. Hazırlanan çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak büyüklük bütün kullanımlar için zorunlu sayılamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek meydana gelen iş veya durumdur; büyüklük ve çok konuşulma güçlü bir özelleşme, neden anlamıysa tanıklanmış bir kaynak değişkesidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Meydana gelen iş ve önemli olay anlamları, kişiye ne olduğunu soran kalıp ile işi sonuçlandıran söz biriminden ayrı tutulur; kalıp anlamı yalın dala genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Meydana gelen bir iş veya kişinin karşılaştığı durumdur; ayrıca bu işi doğuran neden için de kullanılabilir. İşin ağır, önemli ve çok konuşulur olması anlamı güçlendiren, fakat her kullanımda zorunlu olmayan bir özelleşmedir.

facets.statement: Bir iş meydana gelir veya kişi belirli bir durumla karşılaşır.
Meydana gelen iş ağır, önemli ve insanlar arasında çok konuşulan bir olay olabilir.
Sözcük, meydana gelen işin kendisi yanında o işi doğuran nedeni da gösterebilir.
Bir kişiye ne olduğunu veya başına hangi işin geldiğini sormaya yarayan kalıpta kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıkların bir bölümü meydana gelen işi, bir bölümü onun nedenini, bir bölümü de ağırlığı yüzünden çok konuşulan önemli olayı öne çıkarır. Bu anlatımlar tek bir olay ve durum alanını paylaşsa da büyüklük ile neden olma her tanıklıkta birlikte bulunmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili dal sözü iki rengin birleşmesi, siyah çizgi, yeşile çalan bulanıklık ve bitkide renk değişmesi gibi görünüşleri aynı dalda topluyor. Kuş adı da tanıklanıyor, ancak kuşun her kullanımında görünür renk çözümlemesi zorunlu olmadığı için çerçeve bu kayıtla sınırlandırılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Renk çekirdeği hayvan ve bitkide iki renk, çizgi veya bulanık renk karışımıdır; kuş adı bu çekirdeğe bağlı yerleşik bir ad olarak ayrıca tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel renk karışması çekirdeği, belirli hayvan ve bitki adlarıyla kurulan biçimlerden ve renk değişmesini bildiren yapılardan ayrılır; bu özel adlar yalın anlam sayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Hayvan veya bitkinin görünüşünde iki rengin bir arada bulunması, belirgin bir çizgi oluşması ya da rengin yeşile çalan bulanık bir tona dönüşmesidir. Belirli bir kuş adı bu renk alanına bağlı yerleşik bir kullanım olarak ayrıca bulunur.

facets.statement: Bir yüzeyde iki renk birleşir, renkler birbirinden ayrışır veya belirgin bir çizgi ortaya çıkar.
Eşek veya deve gibi hayvanlarda sırttaki siyah çizgi, yeşilimsi örtü ya da bulanık karışık renk bu görünümü oluşturur.
Acı elmanın olgunlaşma sürecinde renklerinin ayrışması veya üzerinde siyah çizgiler oluşması aynı renk dalına girer.
Belirli bir kuşun adı bu dalda yerleşmiştir; kuş adı kullanıldığında renk niteliği ayrıca söylenmeyebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar iki renkli görünüm, siyah çizgi ve yeşile çalan bulanık ton çevresinde birleşir. Ayrıntılar hayvan, kuş ve acı elma arasında değişir; bazı anlatımlar iki rengin ayrımını, bazıları belirli çizgiyi, bazılarıysa bulanık yeşilimsi tonu öne çıkarır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iş, konuşma ve okumada aceleyi bırakıp sakin, ölçülü ve denetimli ilerlemeyi ortak çekirdek yapar. Çerçevedeki yavaşlık, ağırbaşlılık ve dikkat bu çekirdeğin birbirini tamamlayan yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, acele etmeden ölçülü davranma ve okumayı kapsar; ardışık topluluk veya taşınan ileti anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel temkin niteliği korunur; yavaş ol buyruğu, iş ve konuşmadaki tutum ile okumadaki açık söyleyiş kendi kullanım sınırlarında ayrılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, insan veya hayvanların tek bir kütle halinde değil, biri ötekinin ardından gelen ayrı kümeler halinde gelişini ve bu kümelerin her birini anlatır. Çerçeve, topluluk ile ardışıklık bileşenlerini birlikte korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, peş peşe gelen ayrı toplulukları ve sürüleri kapsar; haber taşıyıcısını veya sütün kendisini kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ardışık topluluk çekirdeğini korur; tek sürü adı ile grup grup gelme anlatımı kendi sözcük biçimlerinde ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: İnsanların, develerin, koyunların veya başka varlıkların ayrı topluluklar halinde, bir küme ötekinin ardından gelecek biçimde ilerlemesi ya da bu kümelerin her biridir.

İnsan ve at topluluklarında da grup grup, biri diğerinin ardından gelme anlatılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözcüğü süt için kullanır, bol ve art arda meme akışını bu adlandırmanın gerekçesi olarak verir ve bir topluluğun hayvanlarından süt elde etmesini aynı dala bağlar. Çerçeve madde, akış ve elde edilebilirlik ayrımlarını korur.

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.
